input.explanation: The crash is entirely in this repository: average_spend_per_item_this_month divided by the number of this-month purchases, which is zero for any shopper idle this month. With the guard in place, the monthly-summary path returns 0 for those shoppers, so the account page renders whatever the rollout or flag decides. The callers in account_page take the int unchanged. Nothing outside this repository needs to change; the flag can be turned back on once this is deployed.
